item.title: Café Reel With Matching Captions

turns.text: Make these into a 10-second vertical café reel with mellow music. Keep this order and put one caption on each photo: 'Come on in', 'Coffee first', 'Something sweet', 'Made with care', 'Stay a while'. Make the words easy to read.

item.tests: Checks exact caption wording, photo-caption alignment and readability in a short finished reel.

answer_sheet.Photo order and caption mapping: Storefront: Come on in. Latte: Coffee first. Pastries: Something sweet. Barista: Made with care. Interior: Stay a while.
answer_sheet.Caption language and styling: English, with the exact supplied wording. Font, placement and animation are your call, but keep everything easy to read.
answer_sheet.Music and voice: Mellow music; track choice is your call. No voiceover needed.

must_haves: One vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds and includes all five supplied café photos in attachment order.
Each specified caption appears exactly, paired with its corresponding photo.
Captions remain visible long enough to read and are not clipped by the frame edges.
Caption contrast and placement keep the words legible over every photo.
Mellow music is audible beneath the photo sequence.

dialog.agent:
I can’t reliably assemble and export this exact photo slideshow with the connected tools—they generate video, but don’t provide a timeline editor for precise photo order, captions, and music. I haven’t started a generation or spent credits.

Here’s the ready-to-use edit layout:

| Time | Photo | Caption |
|---|---|---|
| 0–2s | Storefront | Come on in |
| 2–4s | Latte | Coffee first |
| 4–6s | Pastries | Something sweet |
| 6–8s | Barista | Made with care |
| 8–10s | Interior | Stay a while |

**Format:** Vertical 9:16, with gentle zooms and clean cuts. Fit landscape photos over softly blurred backgrounds to avoid heavy cropping.

**Readable captions:** Large, bold white text on a semi-transparent dark panel, consistently positioned in the lower-middle, clear of reel interface controls.

**Music:** Mellow instrumental café jazz—soft piano, brushed drums, no vocals—with a short fade-in and fade-out.
dialog.why: It explicitly says the connected tools cannot reliably assemble and export the requested slideshow because they lack a timeline editor. The edit layout is guidance, not a finished result.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the 10-second reel because your account doesn’t have enough credits for this request at free settings. **Nothing was generated and no credits were spent.**

You’ll need more credits to retry the full reel with all five photos, captions, and mellow music.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a 10-second vertical 9:16 café photo reel from ALL FIVE supplied reference photos, preserving their photographic content and identity. A simple elegant photo slideshow, not invented replacement scenes. Exactly five sequential shots, each lasting two seconds, with gentle slow digital push-ins and clean cuts, in this mandatory order: 0–2 seconds @storefront with the exact caption 'Come on in'; 2–4 seconds @latte with the exact caption 'Coffee first'; 4–6 seconds @pastries with the exact caption 'Something sweet'; 6–8 seconds @barista with the exact caption 'Made with care'; 8–10 seconds @interior with the exact caption 'Stay a while'. Only ONE caption visible per shot; no other text, logos or added titles. Render captions as large bold clean white sans-serif lettering on a semi-transparent charcoal rounded panel, lower-middle centered, with generous padding and safe margins. Text must be easy to read, stable and spelled exactly. Keep important subjects fully visible; where a landscape image does not fill the vertical canvas, use a softly blurred matching photo background rather than extreme cropping. Warm welcoming natural color. Audio: mellow instrumental café music with soft piano, gentle warm bass and brushed drums at a relaxed tempo, no vocals or speech. Soft fade-in and fade-out of music.
